title: Auto Loans: Loan Balance Settled by a Payoff
content:
For an Auto Loans account being closed with money the borrower moves out of PCB checking, the capital balance that the payoff clears is taken from the loan's activity and not from a stored figure.

## Definition

The capital balance is the sum disbursed when the loan funded, reduced by the capital share recorded on every payment the loan has received, and increased by every payment reversal on the loan. It is stated to the cent.

## How each kind of entry moves the balance

| Entry on the loan's activity | Effect on the capital balance |
|---|---|
| funding disbursement | sets the starting balance |
| any payment (scheduled, capital-only or other) | reduces it by that payment's capital share |
| payment reversal | increases it by the reversal's sum |
| fee entries, settlements and waivers | no effect |

## Illustration (invented activity)

Disbursement 18500.00; capital shares of all payments so far 6420.75; one reversal of 310.20. The capital balance is 18500.00 less 6420.75 plus 310.20, which is 12389.45.
